title: chore: store staging Discord bot token
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` to encrypted Enter staging SOPS
- Keeps the secret change isolated from the Discord feature PR
- Matches the token already verified on the staging Worker

gist.headline: A key for the staging hive
gist.blurb: The staging Discord bot now has its token tucked safely into Enter's encrypted secret garden. Even worker bees need credentials.
gist.summary: Added the verified DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN to Enter's encrypted staging SOPS variables so the staging Worker can run the Discord bot configuration.
gist.impact: Staging deployments can now access the existing Discord bot token reliably while keeping the secret isolated from the feature work.
gist.visual_concept: A secure staging-secret handoff: Polli carries a tiny key toward a locked lime-green garden shed labeled STAGING, while a friendly CRT monitor robot waits beside a retro terminal with a Discord-style chat bubble. Include code-plants and subtle lock imagery to convey encrypted configuration without exposing any secret.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny locksmith tool belt, placing a small key into a locked lime green (#ecf874) garden shed labeled “STAGING”; a friendly CRT monitor robot watches from a warm retro terminal surrounded by code-plants and pastel flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
